candidate.title: Account freeze / un-liquidatable position: getAssetValueAndRisk reverts 'Risk: no risk' once an asset's notional exceeds the top risk segment

ice.exploit_path: Perp; notional (price*amount) exceeds top risk segment via oracle price rise -> getRiskFactor (0,false) -> Risk reverts on every position-touching op.

evidence.attacker_model: Leave a perp position un-liquidatable so its losses become permanent protocol bad debt, and/or freeze a victim account so it can never withdraw or reduce risk.
evidence.preconditions: Perp; notional (price*amount) exceeds top risk segment via oracle price rise -> getRiskFactor (0,false) -> Risk reverts on every position-touching op.
evidence.who_loses: Protocol (unrecoverable bad debt from un-liquidatable insolvent positions)
evidence.who_gains: Account holder dodging liquidation via freeze
evidence.impact: An unhealthy perp account whose notional crosses the top configured risk segment becomes permanently un-liquidatable AND frozen for the owner (no withdraw, no risk-reducing trade, no deleverage), because liquidation/deleverage/trade/withdrawal all evaluate the full-position risk via getAssetValueAndRisk, which reverts. Result: protocol-level bad debt that cannot be socialized away and a denial of all account operations. The margin engine reverts exactly when it is most needed.
evidence.suggested_fix: Clamp notional to the top risk segment instead of returning (0,false); never revert the risk engine for a held position.
